title: advisory-deep-dive audit report
description: One verdict per re-audited advisory (fixed, bypass, variant, incomplete, regressed) plus any findings the non-fixed and non-incomplete verdicts opened. Findings share the vuln-scan and security-deep-dive shape and each cites the advisory it descends from under references.

rule.description: Optional stable bug family as a lowercase slug, the same for every finding of this kind in any repository, e.g. sql-injection, path-traversal, missing-authz-check, integer-overflow-alloc.

anchor.description: Optional short name for the broken root control, written so it survives file moves and line drift: the guard, check or invariant that is missing or wrong, e.g. archive entry names are joined to the extraction root without rejecting parent segments. No file paths, line numbers or finding ids. Two findings with the same rule and anchor describe the same root cause.

instance.description: Optional, only when one root cause is independently attackable at several sites: names this site, e.g. the endpoint or parameter, so it stays apart from the other sites with the same rule and anchor.

validation.description: Paste every PoC file verbatim in a separate closed Markdown fence with language filename=relative/path on its opening line. Use unique safe relative paths and reserve README.md for bundle instructions. Include build/run commands in a sh filename=run.sh fence and output and quoted source excerpts in separate unnamed text or console fences. Close fences on their own lines; do not use --- FILENAME --- delimiters.

discovered_via.description: How this finding was first identified. Folded into prior_art on ingest.
